cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Take My Side
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into your interpretation of a conflict involving a shared relationship.

mechanism: A directs a shared holiday-conflict account, yielding factual completeness to keep B telling it in an order that favors A.
confusable: Unlike concealing facts absolutely, A concedes their inclusion but recruits B to helpful-first framing; borrowed authority survives by accepting B truth boundary.
comparison: Sibling account to Mum differs from a friend mediating an altered allotment rota.
seedUse: Retain D79-a holiday/tickets/driving sequence: its existing A3/A5 control of order already adapts to B cooperation beyond the added S02 status clauses.
